invalidTempo: The tempo isn't valid – using {bpm} BPM instead.
sourceBypassed: “{track}” is silent because its sound source is switched off.
noSource: “{track}” doesn't have a sound source yet – add Drums or a Melody, for example.
extraSource: “{track}” has more than one sound source – “{block}” is ignored.
invalidVolume: “{track}”: The volume isn't valid – using 0.8 instead.
unknownBlock: Unknown block “{type}” – it will be skipped.

block.emptyDrumGrid: The grid is empty – click a few boxes.
block.emptyNoteGrid: No notes yet – click a few.
block.needsScale: This only works with a Melody (it needs a scale).
block.rangeOrder: The end must come after the start.
block.unknownControl: Strudel doesn't know a parameter called “{name}”.
block.unknownControlSuggest: Strudel doesn't know a parameter called “{name}” – did you mean “{suggestion}”?

invalidSection: A section of the arrangement has an invalid length and was skipped.
